name: Sauna 4x+
title: Sauna four or more times per week, 19-plus minutes.
benefit: Strong recovery now and better heart health later.
subtitle: Heat Volume
rationale: The lowest cardiovascular mortality in cohort data appeared at four or more sessions a week of nineteen minutes or longer.

evidence.summary: In cohort data the lowest cardiovascular mortality appeared at 4-7 weekly sessions of roughly 19 minutes or more; causality is not established.

sources.label: Sauna bathing and cardiovascular mortality cohort

indications: Recovery and heat tolerance have flattened at three sessions per week.
avoidWhen: Pregnancy, cardiovascular instability, recent alcohol, or heat intolerance.
